item.title: DHS Shutdown Turns Into Airport Chaos — Security Lines Stretch Up to 3.5 Hours
item.description: Amidst a government shutdown that affects only the Department of Homeland Security, where TSA screeners will have to work while waiting for congress to pass funding before they're paid, we're starting to see more employees failing to show up for work. That's having a significant affect on security lines at several major airports.
